items.title: Paul Shaffer interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, August 24, 2023
items.q: BS&T with their Canadian singer, David Clayton Thomas, and I was at all four shows just taking mental notes

ctx.x: And then I started to become a little more conscious of it, but it took that, it really did take that because I was just fine, in no way did I think I would ever become an arranger or a guy who, you know, can even call an arranger you know, at all. I went to college to study philosophy and sociology which is what you take when you don’t know really what you’re going to do. But the first weekend I was in Toronto for college a night club opened, you know a rock club and sure enough BS&T with their Canadian singer,…
Did the Troggs do the potato solo live?
